messages.text: Hi Jess! I’m very interested in your room in Kangaroo Point. I saw several room photos in the ad—could you let me know which one is currently available? Also, I’m from South Korea and here on a working holiday visa. I’m a tidy and quiet person. If the room is still available, I’d love to arrange an inspection. Thank you!
